question: In which of the following academies were the women candidates allowed to be inducted for permanent commission in September 2021, after the intervention of the Supreme Court of India?
solution:
The correct answer is** "National Defence Academy".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Defence Academy** is the training institute of the Indian Armed Forces where cadets of three services are together i.e Indian Army, the Indian Navy, and the Indian Air Force.
 
• The NDA is located in **Khadakwasla, Pune, Maharashtra.**
 
• Earlier only unmarried males were allowed to take the exam but the Supreme Court of India announced that women will be allowed to take this exam.
 
• The government has decided to allow the induction of women into the National Defence Academy for permanent commission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **​__Rashtriya Military School** - These were established for taking care of the education of defense personnel. It is situated in Doon Valley, Dehradun.

 
 
• There are a total of 13 military schools in India.
 
 
 
• **Officers Training Academy **- These train officers for the Short Service commission. It is established by Indian Army. The first academy is located in Alandur, Chennai. A new academy setup in Gaya.
 
• **Indira Gandhi National Forest Academy **- It is a forestry training institute. It was established in 1938. It is located in Dehradun.
